metadata.description: Marketplace do plugin data-eng-agent: spec-driven development de pipelines de engenharia de dados no Databricks.

plugins.name: data-eng-agent
plugins.description: Spec-driven development para pipelines de engenharia de dados no Databricks: estado local declarativo (YAML) validado deterministicamente contra o Unity Catalog, ciclo SPEC -> PLAN -> RUN com subagentes GENERATOR/EVALUATOR, KB de tabelas SAP/data products e templates deterministicos (CDC, SCD Tipo 1, Metric View, Genie, Data Classification, Quality Monitor).
